title: Booking, Invoicing and Payment of a Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Pack
content:
# Billing Operations Rule — Pack Purchase and Payment, Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs

## 1. Units booked and amount invoiced

1.1 A Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs pack is booked on the purchase date as the pack's purchased units plus its bonus units.

1.2 The pack invoice is the pack's purchased units multiplied by the pack's price per purchased unit, rounded to the cent. Bonus units carry no price and do not enter the invoice.

1.3 Units are booked only to a program whose status is pending payment, active or exhausted.

1.4 A program's letter units are the units the client has paid for and may still use: units bought, bonus units, rolled-over units and credits, less units used and units lapsed.

*Hypothetical illustration.* For a pack of a hypothetical 200 purchased units at a hypothetical 9.50 USD per unit with 8 bonus units, the program is booked with 208 units (200 plus 8) and invoiced 1900.00 USD (200 multiplied by 9.50); the 8 bonus units add nothing to the invoice.

## 2. The expiry date

2.1 The expiry date is the purchase date plus the pack's unit validity in months. Where that day does not exist in the resulting month because the month is short, the expiry date falls on that month's last day.

| Hypothetical purchase date | Hypothetical validity | Expiry date |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-04-10 | 12 months | 2027-04-10 |
| 2026-08-31 | 6 months | 2027-02-28 (February 2027 has no 31st) |

## 3. Invoice due date and usability of units

3.1 The pack invoice falls due the pack's invoice due period, in calendar days, after purchase.

3.2 Units are usable only once the invoice is paid.

## 4. The payment limit

4.1 A program is paid only when the handling date is no later than the payment limit counted from the purchase date.

4.2 The payment limit is the pack's unpaid-invoice cancellation period in calendar days, the day after the purchase date being day one and the last day included. An unpaid program is cancelled on the first day after it.

4.3 The clock starts from the purchase date shown on the program record. Equality is inside the limit: payment on the last day of the limit is accepted.

### Boundary cases on hypothetical dates

Purchase date 2026-03-10, with a hypothetical cancellation period of 30 calendar days. Day one is 2026-03-11, and day 30 — the last day of the limit — is 2026-04-09.

| Handling date | Position | Payment recorded? |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-04-08 | day 29, inside the limit | Yes |
| 2026-04-09 | day 30, the last day, included | Yes |
| 2026-04-10 | first day after the limit | No — an unpaid program is cancelled on this day |

## 5. Points of judgement

**Is the invoice due date the same as the payment limit?** No. The invoice falls due after the invoice due period, while the payment limit is counted on the unpaid-invoice cancellation period. Whether a program is paid turns on the payment limit: a payment is recorded whenever the handling date is no later than the last day of that limit.

**Can units be used while the invoice is outstanding?** No. Units are usable only once the invoice is paid.

**Are bonus units invoiced?** No. Only the purchased units are invoiced.
